title: Sell Papyrus newsrooms through Prospectus
description:
Ryan approved on 2026-10-31 (in the Papyrus session): "it's time to add all that stuff to Prospectus". That means the product setup to sell Papyrus newsrooms: per-site products papyrus-<site>, operator entitlement grants and the route to grant them, account creation and membership changes from Papyrus sites, and billing events and provisioning hooks. He also approved moving the Papyrus CLI onto each site's registered federation client, adding the CLI callbacks and re-reviewing the federation policy.

This epic is the Prospectus side and the cross-repo dependency for the Papyrus plan, which covers the CLI enrollment route on cli-login's prepare/enroll hooks, X-Prospectus-Account selection, fail-closed authorize checks and whoami. It gathers existing stories by dependency instead of duplicating them:
- kanbus-275596: register each site;
- kanbus-592fbb: entitlement grants;
- kanbus-5161d7: account creation from a site;
- kanbus-59284c: the provisioning and invite API;
- kanbus-ef71aa: account-scoped content.

Billing itself is the separate epic kanbus-a78bcd (Stripe and invoices). It was still being planned on branch board/billing-plan and had not reached main as of 2026-10-31.

Facts on 2026-10-31 (Prospectus main ec6dbed):
- accounts/papyrus-sites.json registers 3 sites: papyrus-p-apyr-us, papyrus-pilobol-us and papyrus-shipped (public-reader). Papyrus reports 7.
- Each registered clientId is the Cognito client prospectus-google-only defined in Papyrus amplify/auth/prospectus-google-client.ts.
- papyrusSiteRoutes (accounts/papyrus-sites.ts) has no POST /v1/accounts and no memberships route. Account creation from a site (Papyrus PRs 330/331) is therefore refused by the API policy today.
- The operator entitlement route exists, but no operator holds accounts:admin:entitlements, and the directory BFF policy allows only GET.

Approval gates: every API resource-policy change, new IAM role, operator grant, registration entry and federation review needs Ryan's concrete approval of the synthesized change before merge. Planning record only; nothing here is authorized to deploy.

comments.text: 2026-10-31 (Billing planner): kanbus-a78bcdbc (billing) is on main since 0e04c6a. Division of labour: this epic owns per-site products, family metadata (kanbus-db57cb), entitlement grants, site-driven account creation and memberships, and lifecycle events (kanbus-6efecd); billing owns the plan catalog and prices, billing lines, modes, the invoice ledger and Stripe. Billing consumes entitlement.changed from kanbus-6efecd as an operator prompt to attach or end a plan, never as an automatic charge, until Ryan decides otherwise (billing epic open question 13). The operator-side account setup (create for a client, grant, invite owner) is kanbus-4c99c6 under kanbus-d6b6dc; it complements kanbus-dbc30a (site-driven) rather than replacing it.
